run_grid_search: run a grid search of ML experiments using an Explorer and monitor progress until completion
run_grid_with_clear: run a grid search that cancels previous jobs and clears XP folders before rescheduling experiments
run_grid_dry_run: run a grid search in dry run mode to simulate scheduling without launching any experiments
cancel_grid_experiments: cancel all running experiments in a grid by passing cancel=True to the run_grid function
monitor_grid_progress: monitor the progress of grid experiments and display a treetable of XP states and metrics
